architecture: M1 virtual midpoint bracket -> spread/completed-M5-ATR session gate -> completed-S1 directional quality -> market entry -> hard SL/trail/max-hold -> opposite same-minute rearm

state_machine.minute_start: freeze midpoint=(ask+bid)/2; buy=mid+0.15; sell=mid-0.15; arm both; reset rearms
state_machine.microstructure: build completed 1-second BID OHLC ring; quality uses completed seconds only
state_machine.buy_trigger: ask >= frozen buy boundary + regime gate + positive S1 quality
state_machine.sell_trigger: bid <= frozen sell boundary + regime gate + negative S1 quality
state_machine.order_type: market orders; bracket is virtual/internal, not broker pending stops
state_machine.trailing: activate after +0.10 favorable move; trail 0.03 using bid for BUY / ask for SELL; only tighten
state_machine.rearm: after exit in same minute, arm only opposite side using original minute boundary, max 3
state_machine.next_minute: new frozen midpoint bracket replaces prior cycle

sessions.role: session changes ATR minimum; session alone does not prohibit trading

parity_note: Exact R9 parity depends on ordered Bid/Ask ticks, symbol Point/Digits/tick size, broker stop levels/filling, costs, and OnTick lifecycle. Cross-feed approximations must be labeled R9-style reconstruction.
